about:
Tri W-G Inc. has been manufacturing physical therapy and rehabilitation equipment in Valley City, North Dakota, since 1967. Founded as a medical device maker, the company remains at its original location on 12th Avenue NE, where it produces a range of devices designed for clinical durability.

The product line includes parallel bars, mat tables, treatment tables, trainer tables, and tilt tables, along with a bariatric series that supports weight capacities up to 1,000 pounds. Each unit carries a UL Classified safety label earned through independent testing, and the bariatric models are backed by a 10‑year limited warranty.

Tri W-G serves hospitals, outpatient clinics, rehabilitation centers, and architects specifying equipment for healthcare facilities. Its devices are used in physical therapy, bariatric care, and hospital architecture design, with some early units still in service decades after installation.

The company emphasizes long‑term reliability and risk reduction, building every product to meet stringent safety standards so that clinicians can focus on patient care rather than equipment failure.
